user.title: Jarolift RF
user.description: Paste the config.json of the original ESP32-Jarolift-Controller to take over keys, serial, channels and groups, or enter keys and serial manually. Keys are stored only in Home Assistant and never logged.

data_description.bridge_service: ESPHome device running the jarolift-bridge package (action DEVICE_send_raw).
data_description.config_json: Only keys, serial, channels and groups are read; the text itself is not stored.
data_description.master_msb: Decimal, or hexadecimal with 0x prefix. Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.master_lsb: Decimal, or hexadecimal with 0x prefix. Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.base_serial: 20 bit (max 0xFFFFF). Decimal or 0x… Leave empty to take it from config.json.
data_description.counter_start: Device counter of the old controller + 16 (safety margin). Can only move forward later.
data_description.tx_enabled: Leave off for a receive-only first test. Nothing is sent while off.

import_summary.title: Import from config.json

error.invalid_key: Invalid key (32 bit, not both zero).

abort.no_bridge: No ESPHome device with a send_raw action found. Flash the jarolift-bridge package first and add the device to Home Assistant.
abort.already_configured: This serial number is already configured.

data_description.tx_enabled: Leave off for a receive-only first test. Nothing is sent while off.
data_description.tx_power_dbm: The old controller effectively sent with about 0 dBm.
data_description.bundle_ms: Identical commands within this time are sent as one group telegram. 0 = off.
data_description.legacy_learn: Only for very old receivers. The old controller always used the new mode.

counter_exhausted.message: The rolling-code counter is exhausted (65535). New serial and re-learning required.

stopping.message: Home Assistant is stopping; nothing is sent.

counter_write_failed.message: Counter could not be saved; nothing was sent.

bridge_timeout.message: Radio bridge did not confirm the transmission.

tx_disabled.message: Transmitting is disabled in the integration options.

command_too_old.message: Command dropped: waited too long in the queue.
